title: Common local ranks of a pullback presentation
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] whose canonical tensor-pullback adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] at structure modules are invertible after every base change. Let $E$ on $X$ and $N$ on $T$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], and let $g:T\to S$. Suppose $q^*E\cong p^*N$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For every $h:T\prime\to T$ and point $t$ there exist an open $U\subset T\prime$ containing $t$ and $r\in\mathbb N$ such that the restrictions of $p\prime_*q\prime^*E$ and $p\prime_*q\prime^*(E^\vee)$ to $U$, and $q_U^*E$ on $X_U$, are all finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Here primed projections are for the base change along $h\circ g$, and $q_U$ is the projection for $U\to T\prime\to S$.

proof.text: Compare tensorPullback with the abstract Modules.pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to Modules.pushforward. Prove preservation of finite local freeness by pulling back a finite local frame near the image of each point: restrictFunctorIsoPullback, pullbackComp, morphismRestrict_ι, overIsoFreeEquiv and pullbackFreeIso supply a free frame over each inverse-image open, and these opens cover. The proved source-library instance Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback transfers fixed rank to tensorPullback. For h : T' → T construct b : X_{T'} → X_T with pullback.lift. Its two projection identities and tensor-pullback composition transport the supplied presentation to e' : q'^*E ≅ p'^*M, where M = h^*N.

Use the finite-locally-free dual-pullback isomorphism, transported through the comparison with tensorPullback, at q' and p'. Apply the contravariant dual functor to e' to obtain q'^*(E^vee) ≅ p'^*(M^vee). M and its dual are finite locally free. The unit theorem, using hO at h followed by g, and pushforward of these two presentation isomorphisms give M ≅ p'_*q'^*E and M^vee ≅ p'_*q'^*(E^vee).

Use the proved source-library Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free to choose an open U containing t and a finite local frame of M. Reindex that frame by ULift (Fin r), where r is its finite cardinality, and use overIsoFreeEquiv and restrictFunctorIsoPullback to give U^*M fixed rank r. Prove dual_rank directly from fixed-rank local generator data: overHomObjIso, the contravariant image of each frame, and homObjFreeUnitIso trivialize the dual on the identical cover with the identical rank. Apply this to U^*M and transport with the dual-pullback isomorphism. Restrict the two direct-image identifications to U and transfer their rank predicates. Finally base-change e' along U.ι and pull back the rank-r module U^*M to X_U; transfer fixed rank across that presentation. Reassociate compositions to match q_U. This argument includes r = 0; an empty T' supplies no t.

proof_origin.note: T3 implemented the local-frame argument in Lean, using existing dual-pullback theory and proved private helpers; no new statements or holes. The unit route is unchanged.

A finite locally free sheaf and its dual have equal rank locally and their pushforwards have that rank when pulled back from the base with universally trivial structure sheaf direct image

lean.statement:
theorem picard_pullback_local_ranks {X S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (N : T.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ≅
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N)) :
    ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'),
      ∃ U : T'.Opens, t ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((Modules.tensorPullback U.ι).obj
            ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).obj E))) r ∧
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((Modules.tensorPullback U.ι).obj
            ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).obj
                (Modules.dual E)))) r ∧
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ h ≫ g))).obj E) r
